subject: prd/read-to-rule
statement: The gate convention shall include the sampled full read: at least one full-document read within every five consecutive §0 gates, performed after that gate's §0 pass, its additional findings recorded as outside-§0 items.
rationale: the capture rate needs a denominator; sampling is the standing audit move (brainstorm:gate-attention#D-5)
fit_criterion: every run of five consecutive §0 gates in the window contains ≥ 1 sampled full read; each sample's outside-§0 items (possibly zero) recorded
